card.name: Having enough or plenty of something
card.fires_on: Words in a phrase about a supply being ample, such as spare, unlimited, or hours remaining, right where "plenty" or "enough" could come next. Seen in web text on resources and in sleep-drug labels about hours left before waking.

modes.label: Ample supply
modes.description: Words describing plentiful resources, such as spare capacity, enough water, or unlimited supply.
modes.example: The server is designed to be high powered, with heaps of<< spare>> CPU and RAM.

modes.label: Hours left before waking
modes.description: Label wording about at least some hours of bedtime remaining before planned awakening.
